journal_lines: Kicked something that rang. A geode. Small but real.
Hollow stone underfoot. Broke it open. Violet inside.
The cave had crystals in it. Broke some free.
Stumbled on it. The right kind of stumble.
Hollow knock underfoot. The right response was to investigate.
The rock face here sounded different. Tapped along it until it changed. Found it.
Cracked it on the corner of the stone. The inside was better than the outside.
Picked it up out of curiosity. Heavy for its size. Correct instinct.
Small geode. The crystals compact and dense. Good.
Not looking for this. Found it anyway.
The sound when the rock hit the floor was off. Turned back to look.
